scientific_integrity: All new assertions have a stated analytical derivation; the stationary law and generic resolvent hitting identity are attributed to previous knowledge. Numerical checks are finite corroboration rather than infinite proof; literature priority and proof have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed negative contractive multiplier, Poisson resetting, single target actually hit; no statement for jump-crossing absorption, noncontractive or random multipliers, non-Poisson clocks, or full first-passage distributions. Floating-point partial fractions can be ill-conditioned as |a| approaches one.
title: Certified first-passage series for Brownian reflection–rescaling
